title: Mon Mon Mon Monsters
description: While assigned to community duty, teenagers stumble upon a flesh-eating female ghoul and decide to capture her.

title: Dead Shack
description: On a weekend getaway at a rundown cottage in the woods, a 14-year-old teen, his best friend, and his best friend's older sister must work together to save their hard-partying parents from their predatory person in the cabin next to them.

title: Blood Relatives
description: Francis is a 115-year-old Yiddish vampire who roams the American back roads in his beat-up muscle car, keeping to himself, and liking it that way. One day, he meets a feisty teenager who claims she's his daughter, and she has the fangs to prove it.

title: Who Invited Them
description: Adam and Margo start to suspect their new friends are actually duplicitous strangers with a dark secret.

description:

title: WolfCop
description: An alcoholic cop blacks out and wakes up in unfamiliar surroundings, and crime scenes seem oddly familiar when the full moon is out.

title: Boys from County Hell
description: Some hardy road workers, led by a bickering father and son, must survive the night when they accidentally awaken an ancient Irish vampire.

title: Prevenge
description: A pregnant woman kills an assortment of people.

title: Vicious Fun
description: A horror film critic finds himself in a sticky situation when he stumbles into a self-help group for serial killers.

title: One Cut of the Dead
description: Real zombies attack a hack director and a film crew who are shooting a low budget zombie film in an abandoned WWII Japanese facility.

title: Teddy
description: A young man in a rural town begins to undergo frightening changes after he is scratched by an unknown beast.

title: Scare Me
description: A group of college students ride-share to a music festival and have a campfire story competition on the way. As the stories progress, the tensions rise as they realize they are in a story of their own.

title: Fried Barry
description: Aliens take over the body of a drug addict and take it for a joyride through Cape Town.

title: Scare Package
description: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

title: Slaxx
description: A possessed pair of jeans terrorizes trapped workers at a trendy clothing store.
